hero.title: BIOTECHNOLOGY IN FRANCE FOR INTERNATIONAL STUDENTS

sections.title: 1. Yes, international students can **study biotechnology in France.**

items: Yes. **International students** can apply to eligible **biotechnology programmes** if they meet the academic, language and application requirements of the institution.

sections.title: 2. How long does it take to study Bio-technology in France?

items: A **bachelor’s degree** usually takes three years. A typical **master’s degree** takes two additional years to complete, and a **PhD** normally requires three additional years, depending upon the research project.

sections.title: 3. Need IELTS for studying biotechnology in France?

items: Not everybody needs to sit for the IELTS. English language programmes may require IELTS, TOEFL, another accepted test or alternative evidence of proficiency in English. Instead, French-taught programmes may require proof of proficiency in French.

sections.title: 4. What is the cost of biotechnology in France?

items: For **2026–2027** the national reference registration fee for a master’s programme at a public institution is **€255 per year** for eligible French/EU-category students and **€3,950 per year** for applicable non-EU students. There may be exemptions. Programme-specific arrangements and living expenses are additional.

sections.title: 5. What jobs are there after studying biotechnology in France?

items: Graduates may work in **biotechnology research**, **pharmaceutical manufacturing**, **bioproduction**, quality control, diagnostics, **clinical research**, **regulatory affairs** and **bioinformatics**. The specific requirements depend on the role and the employer.

sections.title: 8. Recognition and Accreditation of Biotechnology Degrees in France**

items: Before registering, check the **status of the qualification** and the institution awarding it.

A **French master's degree** generally consists of two years of study after a bachelor's degree and **120 ECTS credits**. Not all courses labelled as a biotechnology programme are national master’s degrees, however. University diplomas, certificates in continuing education and other specialist qualifications may have a different status.
**Applicants should verify:**
* - The exact name of the qualification.
* - If it is a **state degree** or a university diploma.
* - The number of **credits** (ECTS) obtained.
* - Whether it is laboratory training, a research project or an internship.
* - If the qualification corresponds to their career or further study intentions.

****Biotechnology**** is a broad scientific discipline and many laboratory or industrial jobs are not regulated in the same way as other professions such as medicine or pharmacy. But, an employer may want specific technical skills, experience or additional qualifications.

**For students from India:** If you plan to return to India, please check with the prospective employer and any relevant institution or authority in India regarding the acceptability of the degree before enrolling. Research, teaching, industry and regulated healthcare related roles may have different recognition requirements.

sections.title: 9. Biotechnology salary and jobs in France after**

items: A ** biotechnology degree ** can take you into research , ** biopharmaceutical manufacturing ** , diagnostics , ** quality assurance ** , lab science , product development . The jobs that are open to graduates depend on the level of degree, technical expertise, work experience and language skills they possess.
**Job opportunities in biotechnology**
Possible career paths for graduates include:
* - Research Assistant - Biotechnology
* **Associate, Research & Development**
* - **Technician or laboratory analyst.**
* **Bioprocess Development Associate**
* - Bioproduction technician or engineer (depending on qualifications).
* - **Quality control analyst**.
* - **Quality Assurance Associate**
* - Expert in pharmaceutical or biotechnological production.
* - Coordinator of clinical research.
* - **Assistant in regulatory affairs**
* - **Laboratory specialist (molecular biology/microbiology)**
* - **Bioinformatics analyst**, with appropriate computational skills.
* - **Science project management**.
**Salary requirements**

Salaries vary based on job title, credentials, employer, experience, region and whether the position is in research, manufacturing, quality or management. Entry level lab jobs may not be as lucrative as specialized engineering, bioinformatics, or R\&D roles.
